units.title: Eclipse power
units.text: During orbital eclipse the spacecraft bus is powered by the battery because the solar arrays cannot generate usable power in darkness. Charging resumes after the vehicle returns to sunlight.

units.title: Attitude safe mode
units.text: If the star tracker is unavailable for more than thirty seconds, the flight computer enters sun-pointing safe mode and suspends normal payload pointing until attitude knowledge is restored.

units.title: Downlink reservation
units.text: The mission operations team requests each downlink reservation from the ground-station scheduler. The spacecraft does not choose the station autonomously.

units.title: Reaction wheel desaturation
units.text: Reaction wheel desaturation is scheduled when stored wheel momentum exceeds the mission limit. Magnetorquers unload the accumulated momentum while payload slews are paused.

units.title: Battery heater threshold
units.text: The battery heater turns on when the measured battery temperature falls below minus 5 degrees Celsius and turns off again above 2 degrees Celsius.

units.title: Clock correlation
units.text: Ground software correlates spacecraft event time with the station reference clock after each contact so telemetry timestamps can be interpreted consistently.
